wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain Napa Valley

note.en: Same Howell Mountain appellation and grape. Dunn is a structured, cellar-oriented reference for mountain Cabernet.
note.zh: 同为豪威尔山赤霞珠。Dunn 单宁结构更强，是偏陈年的山地赤霞珠参考。

comparison.name: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry

note.en: A dry German Riesling reference from the Mosel, with a distinct slate-origin profile.
note.zh: 德国摩泽尔干型雷司令的参考，呈现红板岩产区的特色。

sources.label: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry

comparison.name: DAOU Pessimist Paso Robles Red Blend

note.en: A richer-priced benchmark for a dark, fruit-forward California red blend. DAOU identifies Paso Robles sourcing and a different blend.
note.zh: 同属果味浓郁、颜色深的加州红混酿。DAOU 标明来自帕索罗布尔斯，混酿配比另有不同。

note.en: A step up in price within California Cabernet. JUSTIN specifies Paso Robles, a narrower source than the budget label.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，JUSTIN 价位更高，且明确标示更窄的帕索罗布尔斯产区。

note.en: A crisp white that highlights the Pinot Grigio side of Sauvigio. It comes from northern Italy and does not contain Sauvignon Blanc.
note.zh: 清爽的白葡萄酒，可对照 Sauvigio 中灰皮诺带来的风格。它来自意大利北部，未混入长相思。

wines.name: Tazmin Breeze New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc

note.en: A benchmark for crisp New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay specifically comes from Marlborough.
note.zh: 同为清爽的新西兰长相思。云雾之湾的产区明确为马尔堡。

note.en: A Cabernet-led California blend for comparison with an everyday red. Claret has a more defined Bordeaux-style profile.
note.zh: 以赤霞珠为主的加州混酿，可与日常餐酒对照。Claret 的波尔多混酿风格更明确。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: French white sparkling wine at a higher price per 750 mL. Louis Bouillot is an appellation-designated Crémant made by the traditional method.
note.zh: 按 750 毫升折算价格更高的法国白起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 是采用传统法酿造、明确标注产区的勃艮第克雷芒。

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

wines.name: Reserve Meritage Paso Robles 2023 Red Wine

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Blanc de Blancs Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.
note.zh: 风格更丰富的加州干型起泡酒。Domaine Carneros 是标注年份的卡内罗斯混酿。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Brut Rosé Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

note.en: A premium Sonoma Chardonnay comparison from Russian River Ranches, with a citrus-and-barrel-spice profile.
note.zh: 更高价的索诺玛霞多丽参考，来自俄罗斯河谷酒款系列，呈现柑橘与桶陈香料风味。

wines.name: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Pinot Noir

comparison.name: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir

note.en: A pricier Sonoma Pinot Noir with a narrower coastal appellation.
note.zh: 同为索诺玛黑皮诺，La Crema 来自范围更窄的索诺玛海岸产区，价位更高。

note.en: Another southern French white built around Chardonnay. Grand Ardèche uses oak and omits the Viognier in the Maison Barboulot blend.
note.zh: 同为以霞多丽为核心的法国南部白酒。Grand Ardèche 带橡木桶风格，不含 Maison Barboulot 混酿中的维欧尼。

note.en: A separate Pinot Noir sold by Sunshine Mill, the Oregon family operation behind the TJ vineyard bottling. The winery lists this older release separately.
note.zh: Trader Joe’s 这款酒背后的俄勒冈家族酒庄 Sunshine Mill 另有一款高价黑皮诺，酒庄单独列出了这个较早的年份。

sources.label: Columbia Community Connection · winery owner interview

originNotes.en: Winery owner James Martin identified the family’s The Dalles vineyard as the source of the 2023 Pinot Noir for Trader Joe’s.
originNotes.zh: 酒庄负责人 James Martin 确认，Trader Joe’s 这款 2023 年黑皮诺的葡萄来自家族位于俄勒冈州 The Dalles 的葡萄园。

note.en: A specialty Spanish wine that also features real orange flavor. This Málaga Moscatel is sweet and still, so the comparison is about citrus character rather than bubbles.
note.zh: 同样突出真实橙香的西班牙特色酒。这款马拉加莫斯卡托是静态甜酒，适合对照柑橘风味和甜度。

comparison.name: Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced dry pink wine from southern France. Its blend gives a useful contrast with the lighter everyday TJ rosé.
note.zh: 来自法国南部的高价干型桃红。它的混酿可与较轻盈的 Trader Joe’s 日常桃红对照。

note.en: A dry German Pinot Noir rosé on a higher price tier. Villa Wolf comes from Pfalz, whereas Emma Reichart is associated with Rheinhessen.
note.zh: 价位更高的德国干型黑皮诺桃红。Villa Wolf 来自普法尔茨，Emma Reichart 则与莱茵黑森产区相关。

comparison.name: Poggio al Casone La Cattura Toscana

note.en: A higher-tier red from the same Tuscan estate. La Cattura is led by Teroldego, while the Governo bottling takes a different stylistic approach.
note.zh: 同一家托斯卡纳酒庄的高价红酒。La Cattura 以特罗德哥为主，与这款采用 Governo 风格的酒配方不同。

originNotes.en: Poggio al Casone is the estate behind the Casone Toscana line. The wines listed here are separately named bottlings.
originNotes.zh: Casone Toscana 系列来自 Poggio al Casone 酒庄。这里的两款酒分别有独立的酒名。

note.en: Same Tuscan grape in a higher-tier Bolgheri bottling. Antinori gives a coastal, appellation-specific reference.
note.zh: 同为托斯卡纳维蒙蒂诺，Antinori 来自沿海的保格利，产区标示更具体、价位更高。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

note.en: A higher-priced lightly sweet rosé with fresh berry flavors. It uses Loire varieties rather than California Zinfandel.
note.zh: 带新鲜浆果味的高价微甜桃红。它采用卢瓦尔品种，与加州仙粉黛的葡萄来源不同。

note.en: A fuller-bodied expression of Shiraz around dark fruit and spice. Bin 28 is Australian and has a more structured oak profile.
note.zh: 同为设拉子，Bin 28 的深色果味、香料感和酒体更强，来自澳大利亚，橡木桶结构也更明显。

note.en: A higher-tier California Sauvignon Blanc emphasizing citrus and acidity, with more specific sourcing than the value bottling.
note.zh: 更高价的加州长相思，以柑橘风味和酸度见长，葡萄来源比平价款更具体。

note.en: A Cabernet-led California blend for comparison with an everyday red. Claret has a more defined Bordeaux-style profile.
note.zh: 以赤霞珠为主的加州混酿，可与日常餐酒对照。Claret 的波尔多混酿风格更明确。

note.en: A step up in price within California Cabernet. JUSTIN specifies Paso Robles, a narrower source than the budget label.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，JUSTIN 价位更高，且明确标示更窄的帕索罗布尔斯产区。

wines.name: Henri Laffard Grand Reserve Brut Champagne

comparison.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut Champagne

note.en: A pricier nonvintage Brut Champagne benchmark. The two houses have distinct blend and reserve-wine programs.
note.zh: 同为无年份干型香槟，黄牌香槟价位更高，两家酒庄的调配和基酒风格各有差异。

wines.name: Almond Creek Almond Flavored Sparkling Wine

note.en: A close California style match because both are almond-flavored sparkling wines. Wilson Creek is the named Temecula Valley bottling.
note.zh: 同为加州杏仁风味起泡酒，是风格较接近的参考。Wilson Creek 是明确标注酒庄的特曼库拉酒款。

wines.name: La Burgondie Cremant De Bourgogne Rose Brut

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle d’Aurore Crémant de Bourgogne Rosé

note.en: Both are Burgundy rosé crémants. Louis Bouillot blends Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Gamay.
note.zh: 同为勃艮第桃红克雷芒起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 混酿黑皮诺、霞多丽和佳美。

wines.name: Charles Shaw Nouveau Red Table Wine 2024

note.en: A juicy French Gamay for comparison with young, fruit-forward red wine. Jadot is an appellation wine and is not marketed as Nouveau.
note.zh: 以鲜活果味见长的法国佳美，可与年轻果香型红酒对比。Jadot 有明确产区，酒款定位也不同于 Nouveau 新酒。

note.en: Both are Carneros Chardonnay. Rombauer is a richer, creamier benchmark for the region.
note.zh: 同为卡内罗斯霞多丽。Rombauer 是酒体更丰厚、口感更绵密的产区参考。

note.en: The same southern Italian grape and Salento origin. It is a separately branded benchmark for Susumaniello.
note.zh: 同为意大利南部萨伦托的苏苏马涅洛葡萄。Forte Incanto 提供独立品牌的同产区参考。

note.en: Both are Langhe Nebbiolo. Perbacco is a more ambitious example with extended maturation.
note.zh: 同为朗格内比奥罗。Perbacco 的熟成较长，可作高价参照。

comparison.name: Sanford Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir

note.en: A higher-priced coastal Santa Barbara Pinot Noir. Sanford comes from Sta. Rita Hills, a different subregion from Caretaker’s Santa Maria Valley.
note.zh: 更高价的圣巴巴拉沿海黑皮诺。Sanford 来自圣丽塔山，与 Caretaker 的圣玛丽亚谷属于不同子产区。

note.en: French Pinot Noir at a higher price tier. Burgundy provides a cooler-climate comparison for the Pays d’Oc bottling.
note.zh: 同为法国黑皮诺，价位更高。勃艮第可作为气候更凉爽的参照，与奥克地区的酒形成对比。

comparison.name: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir

note.en: A premium California Pinot Noir with a specified coastal appellation. It is a comparison for the grape and state, with a different sourcing profile.
note.zh: 标明沿海产区的高价加州黑皮诺，可对照同州同品种在不同产地的风格。

note.en: Dry Sauvignon Blanc from another Loire appellation. Sancerre gives context for Touraine’s citrus and acidity at a substantially higher price.
note.zh: 同为卢瓦尔河谷干型长相思，桑塞尔来自不同子产区，适合对比图赖讷的柑橘风味和酸度，价位也明显更高。

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: A higher-priced white brut from the same Burgundy crémant appellation.
note.zh: 同属勃艮第克雷芒产区，价位更高的白葡萄干型起泡酒。

wines.name: Hark and Holly Glühwein Mulled Wine

note.en: A higher-priced ready-to-warm Glühwein in the German holiday style, with its own seasoning recipe.
note.zh: 价位更高的德式节日热红酒，开瓶后可直接加热。两款酒的香料配方各有特色。

note.en: A more structured California Merlot benchmark from Napa Valley, which gives a narrower appellation and a richer style.
note.zh: 同为加州梅洛。Duckhorn 来自范围更窄的纳帕谷，结构更扎实，风味也更浓。

note.en: A premium California Chardonnay with a more clearly defined Sonoma origin and a citrus-and-barrel-spice profile.
note.zh: 更高价的加州霞多丽，产地明确为索诺玛，风味偏柑橘与桶陈香料。

note.en: A premium example of the rich California Chardonnay style. Rombauer is specifically from Carneros.
note.zh: 浓郁型加州霞多丽的高价参考，Rombauer 明确来自卡内罗斯。

wines.name: Tuatea Marlborough New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc

note.en: Both are Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay is a benchmark for more expressive citrus and tropical fruit.
note.zh: 同为马尔堡长相思。云雾之湾可作为柑橘和热带水果香气更浓郁的高价参照。

wines.name: Vin De Bordeaux B by Fonbadet Bordeaux 2019

reputation.en: A budget Bordeaux that drew attention for the Fonbadet name and an approachable red-fruit profile.
reputation.zh: 这款平价波尔多因 Fonbadet 名称和易接受的红色果味而受到关注。

note.en: A higher-tier bottling from Fonbadet. The château wine is Pauillac, while the B bottling uses grapes grown outside that appellation.
note.zh: Fonbadet 旗下更高端的酒款。正牌酒来自波雅克产区，B 酒款则使用该产区以外的葡萄。

rationale.en: Good value for a straightforward Bordeaux, with limited published tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 作为易饮型波尔多性价比不错，公开品鉴资料有限。

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

officialNotes.en: A dry pink sparkler made entirely from Pinot Noir grown in southern France, with berry and floral notes.
officialNotes.zh: 以法国南部的黑皮诺酿造的干型桃红起泡酒，带有浆果和花香。

reputation.en: Known for its ornate bottle and berry-driven style under $10. The Kitchn recommends it, while another tasting found the bubbles faded quickly.
reputation.zh: 以精致的酒瓶、鲜明的浆果风味和不到 10 美元的售价受到关注。《The Kitchn》推荐这款酒，也有试饮者认为气泡消散较快。

comparison.name: Gérard Bertrand Héritage An 825 Crémant de Limoux Brut Rosé

note.en: A more expensive southern French brut rosé to compare. Its blend and traditional-method production offer a different take on the style.
note.zh: 同样来自法国南部的干型桃红起泡酒，价位更高。它采用混酿和传统法，呈现出不同的风格。

rationale.en: Distinctive fruit and strong value, with mixed impressions of the bubbles.
rationale.zh: 果味鲜明、性价比好，气泡表现的评价有分歧。

note.en: A premium white from the Vinho Verde region. The varietal Alvarinho offers a fuller comparison with the light blend.
note.zh: 同来自葡萄牙绿酒产区。单一阿尔瓦里尼奥酒体更丰厚，可与轻盈的混酿对比。

note.en: A Californian Chardonnay that similarly emphasizes freshness over buttery oak. Mer Soleil uses stainless steel and concrete.
note.zh: 同样强调清新果味的加州霞多丽。Mer Soleil 用不锈钢和混凝土容器酿造，桶味更少。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle d’Aurore Crémant de Bourgogne Rosé

note.en: A French pink sparkling wine at a higher tier. Louis Bouillot is a Burgundy Crémant with appellation rules and traditional production.
note.zh: 高价的法国桃红起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 是遵循产区规定并以传统法酿造的勃艮第克雷芒。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: French white sparkling wine at a higher price per 750 mL. Louis Bouillot is an appellation-designated Crémant made by the traditional method.
note.zh: 按 750 毫升折算价格更高的法国白起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 是采用传统法酿造、明确标注产区的勃艮第克雷芒。

comparison.name: E. Guigal Côtes du Rhône Rouge

note.en: A more expensive southern French red with a prominent Syrah component. The Rhône blend has a different set of supporting grapes.
note.zh: 同样突出西拉的高价法国南部红酒。罗讷河谷这款采用不同的混酿配方。

note.en: A higher-priced northeastern Italian sparkling rosé. Mionetto specifies Prosecco DOC and a Glera/Pinot Noir blend.
note.zh: 更高价的意大利东北部桃红起泡酒。Mionetto 是 Prosecco DOC，以歌蕾拉和黑皮诺混酿。

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

wines.name: Reserve North Coast Brut Sparkling Wine

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.
note.zh: 风格更丰富的加州干型起泡酒。Domaine Carneros 是标注年份的卡内罗斯混酿。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: French white sparkling wine at a higher price per 750 mL. Louis Bouillot is an appellation-designated Crémant made by the traditional method.
note.zh: 按 750 毫升折算价格更高的法国白起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 是采用传统法酿造、明确标注产区的勃艮第克雷芒。

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

officialNotes.en: A crisp Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with grassy aromatics, bright fruit and tart green-apple character.
officialNotes.zh: 清爽的马尔堡长相思，带有青草香、明亮果味和青苹果般的酸度。

reputation.en: An inexpensive introduction to Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. A tasting of the 2022 highlighted gooseberry, grapefruit and cut grass.
reputation.zh: 适合低预算入门的马尔堡长相思。2022 年份的一篇品鉴记录提到醋栗、葡萄柚和青草香。

note.en: Both are Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay is a benchmark for more expressive citrus and tropical fruit.
note.zh: 同为马尔堡长相思。云雾之湾可作为柑橘和热带水果香气更浓郁的高价参照。

rationale.en: Classic regional character at a good price, based mainly on older tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 产区特色清晰，价格实惠，评分主要参考较早的品鉴资料。

note.en: The same grape and Abruzzo appellation. The Marina Cvetic wine comes from a higher producer tier with more extended oak maturation.
note.zh: 同葡萄品种且同属阿布鲁佐产区。Marina Cvetic 是更高阶的系列，橡木桶陈年也更长。

comparison.name: Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced dry pink wine from southern France. Its blend gives a useful contrast with the lighter everyday TJ rosé.
note.zh: 来自法国南部的高价干型桃红。它的混酿可与较轻盈的 Trader Joe’s 日常桃红对照。

note.en: A higher-priced peach-flavored wine for the same juicy, sweet profile. It adds bubbles to the comparison.
note.zh: 价位更高的蜜桃风味甜酒，延续多汁香甜的风格，另有气泡。

note.en: A higher-priced sweet watermelon-flavored comparison. The Stella Rosa is lightly sparkling.
note.zh: 同为甜型西瓜风味，Stella Rosa 价位更高，并带轻微气泡。

note.en: An appellation benchmark for Viognier’s floral and stone-fruit character. Condrieu comes from the northern Rhône and is markedly richer.
note.zh: 维欧尼花香与核果风味的高端产区参照。孔德里约来自北罗讷河谷，酒体更浓厚。

wines.name: Plat Rsv Cabernet Sauvignon Stags Leap District Napa Valley 2023

comparison.name: Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars FAY Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: Both are Stags Leap District Cabernet. FAY is a single-vineyard Napa benchmark at a much higher price.
note.zh: 同为纳帕谷鹿跃区赤霞珠。FAY 是价位高得多的单一园代表。

note.en: A more costly Mediterranean Vermentino to compare with the Vermentino-led character. The Antinori is Italian and has no Sauvignon Blanc component.
note.zh: 更高价的地中海维蒙蒂诺，可用来对照这个品种的个性。Antinori 来自意大利，未混入长相思。

reputation.en: The 2023 Paso Robles Grand Reserve has drawn favorable coverage for delivering a full Bordeaux-style red at a modest price.
reputation.zh: 2023 年帕索罗布尔斯 Grand Reserve 以平实价格提供醇厚的波尔多风格红酒，获得正面品鉴评价。

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

rationale.en: Substantial regional character and excellent value for a Bordeaux-style blend.
rationale.zh: 产区特色明确，作为波尔多风格混酿性价比突出。

wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Rutherford Napa Valley 2023

officialNotes.en: Rutherford Lot 11. The label identifies Isolated Cellars as the bottler. Trader Joe’s withheld the vineyard name.
officialNotes.zh: 卢瑟福第 11 批次。酒标注明由 Isolated Cellars 装瓶。Trader Joe’s 未公开葡萄园名称。

reputation.en: The 2023 Rutherford bottling is sought out as a $20 entry into a well-known Napa appellation.
reputation.zh: 2023 年份凭借约 20 美元的价格和知名的卢瑟福产区受到关注。

note.en: A higher-priced estate Cabernet from Rutherford. Its fruit comes from a specifically identified estate.
note.zh: 同产区的高价卢瑟福赤霞珠，这款酒明确使用自家庄园葡萄。

rationale.en: A strong price for Rutherford Cabernet and positive published tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 在卢瑟福赤霞珠中价位较低，有正面的公开品鉴支持。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2021 Lot #139

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

wines.name: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon 2023

note.en: A higher-priced Sonoma County Cabernet from the narrower Knights Valley appellation, with firmer tannins.
note.zh: 同为索诺玛县赤霞珠。Beringer 来自范围更窄的骑士谷，价位更高，单宁更扎实。

wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2023

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

note.en: Same grape and Carneros appellation. Etude is a higher-tier estate reference with separately documented vineyard sourcing.
note.zh: 同为卡内罗斯黑皮诺。Etude 是更高价的庄园酒，有单独公开的葡萄园资料。

note.en: Same grape and Carneros growing region. Rombauer presents a richer, creamier interpretation.
note.zh: 同为卡内罗斯霞多丽。Rombauer 的酒体更醇厚，奶油口感更突出。

wines.name: Reserve Chardonnay Arroyo Seco Monterey County 2023 Lot #262

note.en: Both are Arroyo Seco Chardonnay. Riva Ranch is a vineyard-specific comparison with a richer barrel-influenced profile.
note.zh: 同为阿罗约塞科霞多丽。Riva Ranch 是来自特定葡萄园、桶陈风味较浓的参考。

wines.name: Reserve Zinfandel Paso Robles Adelaida District 2023 Lot #265

note.en: A higher-tier Adelaida District Zinfandel from the Beckett family’s Peachy Canyon winery. Bailey is a named vineyard bottling with a distinct vintage and vineyard identity.
note.zh: 贝克特家族旗下 Peachy Canyon 酒庄的高端 Adelaida District 仙粉黛。Bailey 有明确的葡萄园和年份。

sources.label: Reverse Wine Snob · Lot 265 back label

originNotes.en: 2023 Lot 265 names Beckett Family as producer and bottler. The label does not identify Bailey Vineyard or establish a shared lot.
originNotes.zh: 2023 年 Lot 265 背标注明由 Beckett Family 酿造并装瓶。公开资料未确认该批次使用 Bailey 葡萄园的葡萄。

officialNotes.en: A Paso Robles Cabernet with ripe dark fruit and a touch of tobacco in the retailer’s tasting description.
officialNotes.zh: 来自帕索罗布尔斯的赤霞珠。官方品鉴描述提到成熟的深色水果和一丝烟草香。

reputation.en: A soft, fruit-forward Cabernet led by cherry and vanilla. Tastings disagree on how much structure it offers.
reputation.zh: 口感柔和、果味突出的赤霞珠，以樱桃和香草风味为主。不同品鉴者对它的结构感评价不一。

note.en: Also a Paso Robles Cabernet. Hilltop brings firmer structure and extended French-oak aging.
note.zh: 同为帕索罗布尔斯赤霞珠。Hilltop 的结构更扎实，并经过较长时间的法国橡木桶陈年。

rationale.en: Appealing fruit and value, with less tannic grip than some Cabernet drinkers may expect.
rationale.zh: 果味讨喜、性价比好，单宁力度较轻。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Yountville Napa Valley 2023

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

wines.name: Super Happy Cabernet Sauvignon Sangiovese & Malbec

note.en: A richer California red-blend reference with Cabernet and Malbec in a Bordeaux-style blend. Sangiovese gives Super Happy a different mix.
note.zh: 高价的加州红混酿参考，含赤霞珠和马尔贝克，偏波尔多风格。Super Happy 另加入桑娇维塞。

note.en: A higher-priced seasonal dessert-wine comparison for baking-spice character. Oliver uses an apple-wine base, so the comparison is about flavor.
note.zh: 价位更高的季节性甜酒，适合对照烘焙香料的风味。Oliver 的基酒是苹果酒。

wines.name: Motif Cabernet Sauvignon Red Hills Lake County

note.en: Same Red Hills Lake County appellation and lead grape. Obsidian Ridge is a higher-tier mountain vineyard expression.
note.zh: 同属红山湖县产区，以赤霞珠为主。Obsidian Ridge 是更高阶的山地葡萄园酒。

note.en: Sonoma County Syrah at a higher tier. Pax makes a hillside blend using whole clusters and concrete.
note.zh: 同为索诺玛县西拉。Pax 的山坡混酿采用整串发酵和混凝土容器。

originNotes.en: The 2022 bottle was attributed to custom producer Bozzano & Co. The exact vineyard and lot are undocumented in the sources consulted.
originNotes.zh: 2022 年份的品鉴资料把酿造方指向定制酒商 Bozzano & Co.。现有资料未公开葡萄园和批次号。

note.en: A premium Napa Valley Chardonnay benchmark with broader appellation sourcing than Yountville.
note.zh: 高价纳帕谷霞多丽的参照，葡萄产区覆盖范围比扬特维尔更广。

note.en: Same Washington appellation and lead grape. LUKE documents a multi-vineyard blend and uses both French and American oak.
note.zh: 同为华盛顿州瓦卢克坡、以赤霞珠为主。LUKE 公开了混酿的葡萄园来源，并使用法国和美国橡木桶。

sources.label: Reverse Wine Snob · Lot 253 back label

originNotes.en: 2022 Lot 253 names DNA Vineyards for vinting and bottling. This identifies the bottler without naming individual vineyards.
originNotes.zh: 2022 年 Lot 253 背标注明由 DNA Vineyards 整理酒液并装瓶，未披露具体葡萄园。

wines.name: Trading Post Cabernet Sauvignon of Napa Valley 2022

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

note.en: A higher-tier Chilean red from the same Maule Valley and vintage. Gillmore’s blend has its own vineyard and composition.
note.zh: 同来自智利莫莱谷、同为 2020 年份的高价红酒。Gillmore 有自己的葡萄园来源和混酿配比。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Pinot Noir Santa Lucia Highlands 2021 Lot #118

note.en: A Santa Lucia Highlands Pinot Noir from the same appellation. Morgan documents its vineyard and clone blend.
note.zh: 同属圣卢西亚高地的黑皮诺。Morgan 提供明确的葡萄园和克隆品系资料。

note.en: A premium Sonoma Chardonnay comparison from Russian River Ranches, with a citrus-and-barrel-spice profile.
note.zh: 更高价的索诺玛霞多丽参考，来自俄罗斯河谷酒款系列，呈现柑橘与桶陈香料风味。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Alexander Valley Lot #117

comparison.name: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: The same appellation and grape make this a useful comparison. Silver Oak has a distinctive American-oak profile.
note.zh: 产区和葡萄品种相同。Silver Oak 的美国橡木桶风格较鲜明。

note.en: A Cabernet-led California blend for comparison with an everyday red. Claret has a more defined Bordeaux-style profile.
note.zh: 以赤霞珠为主的加州混酿，可与日常餐酒对照。Claret 的波尔多混酿风格更明确。

note.en: A Cabernet-led California blend for comparison with an everyday red. Claret has a more defined Bordeaux-style profile.
note.zh: 以赤霞珠为主的加州混酿，可与日常餐酒对照。Claret 的波尔多混酿风格更明确。

wines.name: Reserve Pinot Noir Santa Barbara County 2022

comparison.name: Sanford Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir

note.en: Both are Santa Barbara County Pinot Noir. Sanford narrows its origin to the cool Sta. Rita Hills.
note.zh: 同为圣巴巴拉县黑皮诺。Sanford 来自气候凉爽、范围更窄的圣丽塔山。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Zinfandel Dry Creek Valley Sonoma 2021

note.en: A premium Sonoma Zinfandel benchmark, with the emphasis on old-vine sourcing.
note.zh: 高价索诺玛仙粉黛的参考，侧重老藤葡萄。

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Alexander Valley 2020

comparison.name: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: The same appellation and grape make this a useful comparison. Silver Oak has a distinctive American-oak profile.
note.zh: 产区和葡萄品种相同。Silver Oak 的美国橡木桶风格较鲜明。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Brut Rosé Sonoma County

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville Napa Valley 2020

comparison.name: Nickel & Nickel Sullenger Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: An Oakville single-vineyard Cabernet for a closer appellation comparison.
note.zh: 可作更贴近产区的参考，同为奥克维尔赤霞珠，且标明单一葡萄园。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Brut Sparkling Wine Sonoma County

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.
note.zh: 风格更丰富的加州干型起泡酒。Domaine Carneros 是标注年份的卡内罗斯混酿。

comparison.name: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: The same appellation and grape make this a useful comparison. Silver Oak has a distinctive American-oak profile.
note.zh: 产区和葡萄品种相同。Silver Oak 的美国橡木桶风格较鲜明。

wines.name: Grand Reserve Pinot Noir Carneros Lot 23

note.en: A higher-priced Carneros Pinot Noir from the same appellation. Etude has its own estate sourcing and élevage.
note.zh: 同属卡内罗斯的高价黑皮诺。Etude 的葡萄来源和熟成方式各有特色。

note.en: A higher-priced Carneros Pinot Noir from the same appellation. Etude has its own estate sourcing and élevage.
note.zh: 同属卡内罗斯的高价黑皮诺。Etude 的葡萄来源和熟成方式各有特色。

note.en: A higher-tier dry pink sparkling wine with a traditional-method California profile. The price comparison is per 750 mL.
note.zh: 价位更高的干型桃红起泡酒，呈现加州传统法风格。价格按 750 毫升折算。

wines.name: Ghost Vine Red Blend with Spices

note.en: A higher-priced recipe-driven spiced red wine. Winzerwald is sold as Glühwein for warming, a useful contrast with the spiced red blend.
note.zh: 价位更高、同样以香料为特色的红酒。Winzerwald 属于适宜加热的 Glühwein，可对照这款香料混酿。

wines.name: Villa Antica Asolo Prosecco DOCG Superiore

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2020

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

note.en: A full-bodied California Cabernet comparison with firmer tannins and a named Sonoma subregion. The comparison is about grape and regional style.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，可对照更饱满的酒体和更扎实的单宁。Beringer 还标明了索诺玛骑士谷子产区。

note.en: A higher-priced northeastern Italian sparkling rosé. Mionetto specifies Prosecco DOC and a Glera/Pinot Noir blend.
note.zh: 更高价的意大利东北部桃红起泡酒。Mionetto 是 Prosecco DOC，以歌蕾拉和黑皮诺混酿。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

wines.name: Petit Reserve Cabernet Franc Paso Robles 2021

comparison.name: J. Wilkes Paso Robles Highlands District Cabernet Franc

note.en: Same grape, 2021 vintage and wider Paso Robles region. J. Wilkes is a Miller Family brand and specifies the Highlands District. There is no documented shared lot.
note.zh: 同为 2021 年帕索罗布尔斯品丽珠。J. Wilkes 属于 Miller Family，且标明来自 Highlands District，暂无证据表明是同一批次。

sources.label: The California Wine Club · J. Wilkes 2021
J. Wilkes · Miller Family Wine Company

originNotes.en: The back label lists Miller Family as cellarer and bottler. The vineyard and lot were not verified.
originNotes.zh: 背标注明由 Miller Family 窖藏并装瓶，葡萄园及批次尚未核实。
